_note: Hand-edited. Commit after each update. China M2: monthly, PBoC ~14th. CB gold/COFER/AI: quarterly. ETF flows: weekly when possible.

scenario.notes: Tight policy for longer is still the base case. Money keeps expanding; risk transmission does not. Energy premiums and real rates can soak up print before it reaches BTC. The thesis is decided on the floors, not the rhetoric.
scenario.next_check: FOMC path · hyperscaler earnings (early Aug) · weekly BTC vs $53k · oil if path toward $100

C — HY OAS above 4% or hyperscaler capex cuts
D — oil path toward $100–120 / supply shock

divergence.note: Since mid-2025, BTC has not tracked expanding money the way it used to (global M2 = multi-year destination; spot ETF = short-run pipe). Clock is manual. Do not reset on a single green ETF week — need sustained ETF + liquidity direction agreement first.
